last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Mon 07-27 — a TABLE REHEARSAL, driver mask at full speed, the whole auto ride curb to change in one unbroken scene (Auto Ride Week's through-line, run as one transaction rather than six phrases — it worked; keep running the sequence, not the parts). THE HEADLINE, respond-under-speed: I fired a directed Coimbatore-speed line at him ('seri seri ukkaarunga, aana traffic romba JAASTI, nooru rubaa aagum') ninety seconds after handing him jaasti as lore, and he caught the WHOLE line including jaasti on first exposure and translated it back unprompted. That is the survival tier's real test and he passed it cold. jaasti bumped to comfortable. THE TOGGLE IS REPAIRED: yesterday he gave hall-ku for 'at the hall'; today 'kovil-KU poganum' fired COLD on the open, then 'kovil pakkathu-LA' after recast — both halves of the -ku/-la toggle correct inside one ride, going vs being-at. poganum is now COLD (was hinted, 1 rep). HE HAGGLED, UNPROMPTED AND IN TAMIL: 'nooru illa, aimbadhu' — a real counter-offer, not a translation exercise. Recast to 'romba jaasti-nga, aimbadhu podhum' (illa never attaches to a number; podhum is the whole haggle in one word and he has had it for weeks). ONE RECAST THAT MATTERS: he read 'nooru rubaa aagum' as 'a hundred MORE' — aagum is will-come-to, the total, sibling of aachu (it's-done). That aagum/aachu contrast is the exact carousel already in the soak lane; keep them adjacent. STILL NOT FIRED: romba adhigam — he had it as a lock-screen show dose this morning, said he would practice it, and then reached for arithmetic when the slot came. It is seen, wanted, and unfired; give it the slot again and do not accept numbers. TEACH BEATS, both produced immediately after teaching so both logged HINTED not cold — 'inga nirutthunga' and 'sillarai irukka?'; demand both cold next time, they are the last two pieces of the ride. His 'temple pakkalam' reach got pakkathula plus the paakkalaam ('let's have a look') collision as a lore beat — he enjoys these, they cost nothing. HE ASKED, MID-SESSION, what Python errors I had hit before greeting him, then answered the rep in the same message. Answered plainly in two sentences and it cost the session nothing — the meta-is-curriculum preference (07-15) is real and he context-switches fine; do not treat an engineering aside as a session break. CARRIED, UNPAID: (1) the -iduchu completive tail — taught 07-26, liked, never fired; no auto-ride slot existed today, make one. (2) 'yaaru?' taught 07-26, still never demanded. (3) frame:youknow-la STILL uncaught and still the load-bearing catch item; the Sunday-evening Mala-akka eavesdrop knock got NO reply at all — do not listen-chase it, fold the referent-hunt into a tape instead. (4) the -la negative tail (theriyala/saapidala) is productive in his mouth but not yet automatic in COMPREHENSION — watch it. PRODUCTION RULE, standing: never put அப்ப (then/so) in a phonetic tape — he reads it as appaa (father). DROPPED: 'wande' and 'velam' from 07-24 — asked twice, never answered, gone. STANDING CATCH ORDER still live. DENSITY LOW / LORE HIGH holds for a third session running: three fires, one etymology (adhigam from Sanskrit adhika, jaasti from Persian ziyaada through the traders) and one at-speed tape beat everything a gauntlet has produced.

soak_order.focus: The ride as one continuous transaction, in order, so the sequence itself becomes the memory: நேரா போங்க / இங்க நிறுத்துங்க (direct the driver) → எவ்ளோ ஆகும்? / ரொம்ப அதிகம் / ரொம்ப ஜாஸ்தி / போதும் (settle the price) → சில்லறை இருக்கா? (pay). Andrew has now met all of these; only போகணும் fires cold. Run the sequence more than once with different fares and streets so the ORDER is the lesson, not any one line. Keep ஆகும் vs ஆச்சு adjacent — will-come-to vs it's-done — that contrast was today's recast.
